notes: Single source of truth for all visual decisions. The frontend developer consumes tokens.css (Vue bindings via CSS custom properties) or imports tokens.json directly into a JS/TS build step. UAT reads this file plus fidelity-rules.md to verify visual fidelity. All colors target WCAG 2.1 AA contrast against their paired surface/text roles.

violet_900.description: Deepest violet. Brand mark, hero text on light surfaces, headline emphasis.

violet_800.description: Header bar (parent SPA), high-contrast violet surface.

violet_700.description: Primary surface fill for parent app. Section headers, nav rail active.

violet_600.description: Primary interactive surface (kid kiosk CTA, primary buttons on light bg).

violet_500.description: Hover for violet_600. Secondary violet (links, accents).

violet_100.description: Tinted surface for kid side. Soft card background, tag chips.

violet_050.description: App background tint on kid side. Hero zone wash.

sunshine_500.description: Hero accent on kid side. Streak fire, celebratory CTAs, points badge.

sunshine_400.description: Hover for sunshine_500. Disabled state of CTA.

sunshine_200.description: Tint for badge backgrounds, soft highlight.

ink_100.description: Hairline borders, dividers on light surfaces.

success_600.description: Success text/icon. Points awarded confirmation, approved states.

warning_600.description: Warning text/icon. Pending review flags, deadline approaching.

danger_600.description: Error text/icon. Destructive actions, validation errors.

skip.description: Skip action surface (text button on kid side).

paired_contrast._comment: Pairs that the design must keep within WCAG AA: foreground_text_on_background ≥ 4.5:1 for body text, ≥ 3:1 for large/UI. Audit each pair.

primary.description: Parent SPA + kid SPA + system UI. Inter for crisp UI text; system fallback for offline/loading.

display_kid.description: Kid-side celebratory copy only. Serif gives the streak milestone a slightly storybook feel without being cute.

scale._comment: Type scale uses a 1.250 (major third) ratio. Sizes in dp (CSS px). Line heights are unitless. letter-spacing in em.

display_lg.usage: Parent hero headers, kid welcome screen headline.

display_md.usage: Section headers, kid milestone celebratory headline.

title_lg.usage: Modal titles, page titles on parent SPA.

title_sm.usage: Inline emphasis, sub-section headers, button text.

body_lg.usage: Kid primary body. Larger hit-target context.

body_md.usage: Parent primary body, descriptions, list rows.

label_md.usage: Tag chips, button text (default), tab labels.

code_lg.usage: Household code display (parent SPA). Tabular spacing.

spacing._comment: 4dp base grid. Token names use t-shirt sizes so screens stay readable at scale. Use these for padding/margin/gap; never raw px.

section_gap.description: Vertical gap between major sections on a screen.

inline_gap.description: Horizontal gap between adjacent chips, tags, icon+label.

touch_target_padding.description: Padding inside buttons (vertical) to clear 44dp hit target.

screen_padding_x_wide.description: Horizontal padding when viewport >= 768dp (tablet/desktop parent SPA).

nav_height_compact.description: Bottom nav height (kid SPA + parent SPA mobile).

nav_height_tall.description: Side nav rail width (parent SPA desktop).

radius._comment: Radii in dp. Never round the same value for very large surfaces (a 24-radius hero card looks like a pill).

card_radius.description: Standard card surface (chore card, reward card, kid pool row).

card_radius_hero.description: Hero card (kid welcome, streak milestone, redemption celebration).

shadow._comment: Three elevation levels. Use shadows sparingly on parent SPA (quiet palette); the kid SPA uses them more freely to create depth.

shadow_0.description: Flat. Hairline border separates surfaces instead.

shadow_brand.description: Brand-tinted glow on primary CTAs (kid side only).

motion._comment: Durations in ms. Easings expressed as cubic-bezier. Keep motion short; this is a productivity app, not a game.

duration_fast.usage: Button press, chip toggle, hover color shifts.

duration_base.usage: Card hover, input focus ring transition, default UI motion.

easing_standard.description: Material-style standard curve for entrances and most transitions.

easing_emphasized.description: Reserved for celebratory / hero moments. Slight overshoot.

respect_prefers_reduced_motion.description: When prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, all durations clamp to 0ms and easing becomes linear.

z_index._comment: Use these tokens, never raw z-index values. Leave room for future overlays without renumbering.

z_modal_nested.description: Nested confirm on top of a modal.

breakpoint._comment: Mobile-first; the kid SPA is mobile-only in practice. Parent SPA has a desktop view for ergonomic chore/reward management.

bp_md.description: Tablets. Parent SPA nav becomes a rail.

touch_target._comment: WCAG 2.5.5 target size AAA is 44x44 CSS px. All interactive elements must meet this minimum.

min_size_kid.description: Kid SPA uses a larger minimum because the user is a child.
